# Neo4j Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.neo4j.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.neo4j.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, graph |

Neo4j 5 graph database used as the canonical content graph store. Bound data, logs,
import, and plugins directories live under the configured data root for inspection.
